strategy.title: What If We Experienced Nature at 10× Scale?
strategy.hook: Changing one condition turns a forest ecosystem into a thought experiment with surprising consequences.

story_structure.opening: Establish normal a forest ecosystem and clearly identify the single rule that will change.
story_structure.escalation: Follow three cause-and-effect consequences, increasing the stakes at each step.
story_structure.takeaway: Return to reality and show what the scenario reveals about how a forest ecosystem actually works.

strategy.audience: Curious learners who save and share clear visual explanations.
strategy.visual_direction: Cause-and-effect triptych for a forest ecosystem; normal baseline on left, altered 10× world at center, cascading consequences on right, cinematic visual continuity
